description: Capability matrix update: grant/revoke capabilities with the lock-out guard.

cases.log: Capabilities replaced; audit row RolePermissionsUpdated (details { name, before, after }); log "Permissions for role {RoleId} changed by {ActorId}; 2 account(s) to notify."; capabilities-changed notice sent after commit
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Roles: "Quản trị viên" [AdminUsers], "Thư ký" [MeetingCreator], 2 active accounts hold "Thư ký".
cases.return: RolePermissionResult Success (MSG16) with the matrix showing "Thư ký" = [MeetingCreator, MinutesEditor]; the 2 active holders are told their capabilities changed, their sessions stay.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Role "Thư ký" already holds exactly [MeetingCreator].
cases.return: RolePermissionResult Success (MSG16) with the unchanged matrix; nothing written, no audit row, nobody notified.

cases.inputs: roleId: <random Guid with no role>; capabilities: [MeetingCreator].
cases.log: Warning log "Permission configuration for role {RoleId} rejected: ...".
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
cases.return: RolePermissionResult InvalidConfiguration (MSG17) with errors[roleId] = "Vai trò không hợp lệ."; nothing saved.

cases.inputs: roleId: "Thư ký"; capabilities: [(Capability)999] (a value outside the catalogue).
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Role "Thư ký" exists.
cases.return: RolePermissionResult InvalidConfiguration (MSG17) with errors[capabilities] = "Danh sách quyền chứa giá trị không hợp lệ."; nothing saved.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Unknown role and invalid capability submitted together.
cases.return: RolePermissionResult InvalidConfiguration (MSG17) with errors for roleId and capabilities; the last-administrator rule is not evaluated.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
"Quản trị viên" is the only role holding AdminUsers and its only holder is the actor.
cases.return: RolePermissionResult InvalidConfiguration (MSG17) with errors[adminUsers] = "Không thể lưu cấu hình này: sau khi lưu sẽ không còn tài khoản đang hoạt động nào giữ quyền quản trị người dùng, nên không ai vào được màn hình phân quyền nữa."; the matrix is unchanged.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
AdminUsers is held by "Quản trị viên" and was just granted to "Thư ký", which no active account holds.
cases.return: RolePermissionResult InvalidConfiguration (MSG17) with errors[adminUsers]: a role with no active accounts does not count as an administrator, so the change is refused.

cases.log: Audit row RolePermissionsUpdated; holders of "Quản trị viên" notified.
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
AdminUsers is held by "Quản trị viên" and by "Thư ký", which has 1 active holder.
cases.return: RolePermissionResult Success (MSG16): "Thư ký" keeps an active account with AdminUsers, so someone can still administer.

cases.inputs: roleId: "Quản trị viên"; capabilities: [AdminUsers, MeetingCreator] (AdminUsers kept).
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
"Quản trị viên" holds AdminUsers with active accounts.

cases.log: Shares stopped and audited; audit row RolePermissionsUpdated.
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
"Thư ký" holds [MeetingCreator]; 2 active accounts in the role are viewers of Effective calendar shares.
cases.return: RolePermissionResult Success (MSG16); the Effective shares those accounts view are stopped (reason ViewerLostMeetingCreator) in the same transaction.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
"Thư ký" holds [] and some holders view calendar shares.
cases.return: RolePermissionResult Success (MSG16); no share is stopped (the capability was gained, not lost).

cases.log: Audit row RolePermissionsUpdated; log "...0 account(s) to notify."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Role has no active accounts.
cases.return: RolePermissionResult Success (MSG16); nobody is notified because no active account holds the role.

cases.log: Error log "Saving the permission configuration for role {RoleId} failed."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
The database refuses the save (connection lost, timeout or constraint).
cases.return: RolePermissionResult Failure(SaveFailed) (MSG18); the stored permissions stay as before and no audit row is written.

cases.log: Error log "Permissions for role {RoleId} changed, but telling its accounts failed."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
The change is saved but telling the role's accounts fails (hub unavailable).
cases.return: RolePermissionResult Success (MSG16): the failure is logged, not raised; accounts pick the change up at their next token refresh.

precondition: Roles seeded; admin actor holds role management capability.
